svg.title: Spain sending · Recipient delivery and required public copy
svg.desc: One issued invoice · Eligible private recipient route · Example: recipient delivery confirmed; public-copy response lost. Selected logical scenario: private recipient delivery plus a required public copy. Public recipient delivery is another scenario. The par frame shows independent work, not proof of simultaneous transport. The plan defines permitted dependencies and timing. Spain route and copy rules require qualification. No endpoints, provider query support, deployment boundaries or deadlines are approved. Source: SPEC-SEI-007; Global API handoff: SPEC-SEI-013. Reconcile an unknown action without repeating a completed action.
svg.text: Spain sending · Recipient delivery and required public copy
One issued invoice · Eligible private recipient route · Example: recipient delivery confirmed; public-copy response lost.
Proposed logical sequence · Participants are responsibility groups; actual service placement and contracts remain open.
Solid filled arrow: request · Dashed open arrow: response · Solid open arrow: notification · Time runs down.
par · Eligible independent actions; recorded plan dependencies govern dispatch; no assumed order or synchronous join
Precondition: the ERP has issued the invoice and frozen its business identity and revision. A draft check
cannot authorise sending changed final data.
OUT-05/06 · Draft preparation is outside this sequence
1 · Accept exact issued data; qualify the final route and representation
Save final intent and stable exchange identity.
Same key and input resume the existing exchange;
changed input conflicts. Request receipt is not
Failed, stale or ambiguous lookup holds dispatch. It cannot select the public
recipient route. Final validation or policy failure also stops external actions.
OUT-08/09 · Issued-content issues go to ERP resolution
Freeze the qualified plan and route version. Record delivery and PUBLIC_COPY as
separate actions, with their own destinations, identities and dependencies.
OUT-10 · OUT-INT-06 · Copy exists only if Spain policy requires it
Qualify DTS where transformation is needed.
Validate final bytes after transformation; sign or
OUT-11 · DTS is a reuse candidate, not proven coverage
Save final artefact references and send intent. Before each transmission, save
its attempt, payload hash, target, contract version and original correlation.
2 · Execute separate actions; expose each result without waiting for the other
Save the recipient result and publish the committed change. Recipient delivery
can be visible while the separate public copy is still pending.
Separate operand · Required public-copy action; diagram position does not impose a dependency on delivery
Example exception: no reliable response arrives after possible transmission. The
public-copy outcome is unknown; this is not confirmed rejection.
Save the unknown copy outcome and publish the partial result. Keep confirmed
recipient delivery. Do not resend it or blindly repeat the copy.
3 · Reconcile only the unknown action; keep independent evidence visible
Record the original outcome once and publish the committed change. If no reliable
observation is available, retain unknown and open an owned operations case.
Show recipient delivery and public-copy progress separately, with evidence and
required actions. API receipt, transport acknowledgement and buyer acceptance
OUT-14/15 · Lifecycle spec owns later business outcomes
Issued identity, revision, input digest and key
Logical intake receipt; not external success
API transport and exact fields remain open
Meaning must match this contract milestone
Only where the selected contract supports it
Example: confirms the original copy submission
OUT-14/15 · Authorised read repairs missed updates
Selected logical scenario: private recipient delivery plus a required public copy. Public recipient delivery is another scenario.
The par frame shows independent work, not proof of simultaneous transport. The plan defines permitted dependencies and timing.
Spain route and copy rules require qualification. No endpoints, provider query support, deployment boundaries or deadlines are approved.
Source: SPEC-SEI-007; Global API handoff: SPEC-SEI-013. Reconcile an unknown action without repeating a completed action.
